text:
You’re looking for a backend engineer who can help build a new cloud-based AI solution from the ground up, with clean, maintainable code and the ability to contribute to backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, and API-driven services.

I’m Mina Castellan, and while my background is centered on data analysis and reporting rather than backend engineering, I bring 5 years of hands-on experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, data visualization, and dashboard development. That experience has trained me to work carefully with structured data, spot inconsistencies, organize information clearly, and deliver outputs that are practical and easy to use. I understand how important it is for a product to handle data reliably, and I value clarity, simplicity, and maintainability in the way systems and workflows are built.

Your role emphasizes clean code, pragmatism, troubleshooting, and collaboration in an agile environment. Those are qualities I appreciate and align with strongly in my own work style. I’m comfortable working with detail-heavy tasks, documenting clearly, and staying organized while keeping the end goal in mind. I also understand the importance of data engineering and ETL in a cloud-based product, especially when the solution needs to support AI-driven workflows and dependable service delivery.

What attracts me most to this opportunity is the chance to contribute to something new and innovative. Building from scratch requires not only technical skill, but also discipline, curiosity, and the ability to keep solutions simple and scalable as they evolve. I would be interested in contributing in any areas where my analytical background and data-focused problem solving can support the team, particularly around data organization, reporting logic, and workflow clarity.

If helpful, I’d be glad to discuss how my experience with SQL, data analysis, and structured reporting could support your backend and data-related needs alongside your engineering team. What would be the most important first backend deliverable for this product?
